D.comparison: traditional text-and-formula-based introduction geared toward physicists

O.outcome_detail: intuitive understanding and access to CVQC concepts

cells.quote: The learning material is guided by a series of visuals specifically designed to enhance intuitive understanding of the continuous variable (CV) and GKP encoding, and building on the classical coding theory skills learners from CS will come equipped with.
cells.note: The paper proposes a two-hour session for learners with a classical CS background and without physics requirements, but reports no empirical comparison or outcome data. The contrast is inferred from the paper's discussion of visual learning versus traditional text-and-formula-based material.

D.treatment: visual communication in the proposed learning activity

cells.quote: By engaging visual communication brain regions, it has been shown to boost high-order thinking skills [14] and promote higher research quality for those engaging with it [11].
cells.note: This is a rationale based on cited literature, not a result from an experiment conducted in this study; no effect size or direct test of the proposed GKP activity is reported.

O.outcome_detail: engagement of under-served and under-represented minorities in STEM

cells.quote: The visual approach has also displayed promising impact on engagement of under-served and under-represented minorities in STEM [11].
cells.note: The statement summarizes cited prior work and is not an empirically tested finding about this proposed session.
